steps.text: 10:26 P.M. \ Cloudy
Sunset Boulevard, 'The Ends of the Earth' lounge

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Say baws, what year's this vintage?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hmm, maderized coloring, lively aroma, robust flavor, velvety texture, this is...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Last month. A forty of malt liquor from the corner store.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Perfect scores up and down, baws! That's why they call ya Lungmen's self-proclaimed number one sow-mel-eer!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: *Pfft* How many times do I gotta tell you? This is a reserve weapon. It ain't for drinking! Sora!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay, okay, here's your mouthwash.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Um... did ya mean to wash yer mouth with Yan huangjiu...?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Alcohol is a disinfectant. There's industrial alcohol under the bar. That would do the trick.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: S'all good. We got money so we might as well spend it. It's all in the process, y'know? Ain't the amount. It's the process of spending!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Everybody, the apple pie's ready! It's time to party!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oooh~ Exusiai's homemade apple pie!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Bottoms up!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: ...so like, what exactly are we partying for?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh? It's Bison's welcome party.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: ...so like, where's Bison?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Um! I dunno!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Then pick another reason. We always got a reason to party.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...What are you guys doing?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Awright. Here's the guest of honor himself.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hey. Welcome to The Ends of the Earth.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You're late. That's three shots. Guest of honor drinks triple, but you can't drink. So that's nine sodas. Drink up.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Why is it called The Ends of the Earth?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (And the decor is so gaudy... And what's with the penguin... is this some kind of punk thing...?)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Don't just stand there with your tongue hanging out. This is your welcome party! Apple pie?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...No thanks.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So while me and Mostima were out there fighting off mobsters, you were in here partying?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So... what happened to their leader?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: He got away.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: To be more precise, we let him get away.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Regardless, he got away... so what do we do next?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We know the enemy's identity, their goal, and their numbers.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: They're the Siracusan Mafia, and they wanted to take Penguin Logistics's territory in Lungmen.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...even though we're a logistics firm and... never mind.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Don't sweat it, Texas. We've always got a few days here and there to take out the trash.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: When ya say it like that, it makes us sound even less like a legitimate business, don't it?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: They don't know what they're talking about. They couldn't fill the boss's t-shirt for two minutes without cracking under the pressure.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Penguin Logistics is a unique operation. And I'm a step even more unique.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But that means we have lots of options for how to work this out. Why do we have to fight with them?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: You don't know? How have you been...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Alright, alright, let's not put too much brainpower into this. Find an opportunity to grab their boss, huck him in the river and boom, we're done.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: This whole thing has been one big ass waste of time. I just. Don't. Give. A shit.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Seriously. This isn't really worth spending any more time on. Here, gum.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Om...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But we at least need to come up with a plan to... Wait, what flavor is this gum?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: White Horse Kohl flavor.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Croissant, please add this brand of gum to our hazardous materials list.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We were runnin' low so I grabbed the new flavor. Didn't notice what it was. Oops.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Yo, are we gonna party or what? We got food, we got drinks, where's the tunes?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'm on it~!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I wasn't expecting jazz... even if it's a little...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The previous owner was something of a jazz lover, but after the boss took over we had to make a few style changes.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: A few?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's pretty much because the boss's own records all got toasted in that——

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Enough. Let's not bring back any tragic memories.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: And besides, nobody asked him to go get sick. Here I am takin' time outta my busy schedule to look after his bar.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: is it Oripathy?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Lungmen's been through a lot. They should've changed the way they look at the Infected...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Nah.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: He picked up an alcohol allergy.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: He was fixin' to be the greatest bartender in all Lungmen. Fer a feller like that, we call it terminal.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: We got some party crashers. Yo, get behind the bar if you wanna live.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Nice! There's a coin back here.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Don't squirm around, there's not much room back here——Ow! Watch your halo, Exusiai!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Stop gawking and get down, Bison.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Huh? Ah!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Get 'em!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Welp, that's the end of this place.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Mr. Emperor's still out there. Will he be okay?!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Why are these punks still up in my business? Shoot back already, before they completely trash the joint!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sorry, boss, I'm all out of rubber bullets. Should we go at them with the barstools?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Did I not buy a forty of malt liquor and leave it here for just such an occasion?!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Um, we just drank the last bottle. All we got left is the top shelf stuff.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Use it. I ain't some stuffy old rich man, filling my palaces with fancy show-off booze.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Let this liquor show us what it's worth.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh? But the price on this stuff's higher than——

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Grab it, hold it in your hand, and remember: aim for the head.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Protecting this bar means protecting my land. Come on.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Exusiai.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Got it! Take a bottle and smash a head. No problem!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: W- wait for me!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: They're charging, watch out! Gah!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That's a hundred thousand. Hundred and fifty thousand. Four hundred and fifty thousand. Seven hundred thousand...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: How much was that one? No! Exusiai! Not that one—— agh.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What's... huh...?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Tonight's property damage bill. At least you and I got our shields to fight with. Don't want that number gettin' any bigger.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: R- right.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Okay~ Three, two, one, go!
